pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are primarily polygonal with sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patches in the cervical region exhibit larger spatial area and elongated geometry, transitioning to smaller, more irregularly shaped polygons with increased edge angularity on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with frequent junction nodes, primarily trifurcated. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent across the neck and torso, maintaining high topological connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a continuous, low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck and shoulder, characterized by dense, short vertical hair filaments creating a jagged silhouette.
